parent_objective: design guarded PPO readiness from the newly promoted alpha_1_0 public-gate base
blocked_by: alpha_1_0 is the public-gate base, but no guarded PPO readiness protocol exists
invalidates: running PPO from alpha_1_0 without pre-registered proof/generalization retention and rollback criteria

public_gates: M971 must not use private holdout
M971 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M971 must specify proof retention gates before PPO
M971 must specify fresh generalization and behavior gates before PPO
M971 must specify rollback or rejection criteria for PPO proposals
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat alpha_1_0 promotion as permission for unguarded PPO

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_ppo_readiness: guarded continuation design from the promoted public-gate base
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first post-promotion PPO-readiness gate without running PPO
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/design only; no training, no PPO, no private holdout, no new driver capability claim
stop_condition: stop if proof replay gates are not mandatory
stop if fresh generalization gates are omitted
stop if behavior/ablation retention is omitted
stop if rollback criteria are not explicit
fallback_plan: if readiness design passes, route to smoke-scale guarded PPO proposal implementation
if PPO risk is too high, route to exact repair/projection design before PPO
if generalization coverage is too weak, route to fresh scenario expansion before PPO
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M970 opens a post-promotion guarded PPO-readiness branch after alpha_1_0 public-base promotion

hypothesis: A guarded PPO readiness protocol can be designed for the promoted alpha_1_0 public-gate base without weakening proof, generalization, behavior, or actor-input constraints.
success_criteria: proof replay retention gates are explicit
fresh generalization and behavior gates are explicit
rollback or rejection criteria are explicit
training, PPO, and private holdout remain blocked

commands.name: write_design
commands.command: Write the guarded PPO readiness design for the promoted alpha_1_0 public-gate base.

decision_rule: M971 may only design guarded PPO readiness. It must not update actor parameters, run PPO, change actor inputs, use private holdout, or claim new driver capability.
next_blocker: guarded PPO readiness has not been designed for the promoted alpha_1_0 public-gate base
